canonical_project: China Unicom Gui'an Cloud Data Center Phase II
notes: Phase II of China Unicom (Gui'an) cloud data center: by Feb 2024 main structure, heating, utilities and decoration completed, handover targeted H2 2024; listed as 'East-Data-West-Computing' efficient scheduling demonstration and provincial key project. Racks planned to grow from ~4,000+ to ~10,000 after phase II. Capacity 60 MW = 10,000 racks x 6 kW (design). Same operator as existing Unicom Gui'an entry - phase II expansion.
